channel.title: Worth the Fee
channel.description: Straight answers on whether a travel card or program is worth it for you.

item.title: Rakuten Avis cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?
item.description: 2.5% on November 25, 2026. Rentals picked up in Alaska or outside the U.S. and Canada, and Avis Worldwide Discount rentals, earn nothing.

item.title: Rakuten Ray-Ban cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?
item.description: Up to 12% on November 25, 2026, raised from 4%. Meta glasses earn 4%, other items 12%. Gift cards are the one listed exclusion.

item.title: Rakuten New Balance cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?
item.description: 9% on November 25, 2026, raised from 3%. Limited releases, collaborations, gift cards and orders judged to be for reselling earn nothing.

item.title: Rakuten Victoria's Secret cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?
item.description: 2% on November 25, 2026, with no raised rate. Gift cards, third-party products, reseller orders and orders outside the US site earn nothing.

item.title: Rakuten Columbia cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?
item.description: 2% on November 25, 2026, with no raised rate. Gift cards, pro and employee discount orders and the Star Wars Collection earn nothing.

item.title: Rakuten Saks Fifth Avenue cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?
item.description: 12% on November 25, 2026, raised from 2%. Jewelry, gift cards and orders using a Saks associate discount earn nothing.

item.title: Rakuten Viator cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?
item.description: 11% on November 25, 2026, raised from 2%. Paid on completed tours only; theme park tickets, virtual tours and gift vouchers earn nothing.

item.title: Rakuten Ace Hardware cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?
item.description: Up to 6% on November 25, 2026, raised from 2%; snow equipment earns 3%. Delivery, assembly and gift cards earn nothing.

item.title: Rakuten DSW cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?
item.description: 2% on November 25, 2026, with no raised rate. The part paid with rewards or gift cards and five luxury brands earn nothing.

item.title: Rakuten H&M cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?
item.description: 2% on November 25, 2026, with no raised rate. Sale items earn nothing, and neither do shipping, gift cards or Rabanne items.

item.title: Rakuten Tractor Supply cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?
item.description: 1% on November 25, 2026, with no raised rate. The one listed exclusion is gift card redemption; outside codes may void it.

item.title: Rakuten Under Armour cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?
item.description: 10% on November 25, 2026, raised from 2%. Orders using a code not listed on Rakuten, gift cards and non-US shipping earn nothing.

item.title: Rakuten Instacart cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?
item.description: 1% on November 25, 2026. Orders placed in the Instacart mobile app earn nothing, and neither do alcohol, fees, tips or Instacart+.

item.title: Rakuten Hotels.com cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?
item.description: Up to 3% on November 25, 2026 (3% hotels, 1% cars). Any coupon code ends the cash back, and it is credited only after a completed stay.

item.title: Rakuten The North Face cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?
item.description: Rakuten's The North Face page showed 2% on November 25, 2026. Nuptse, Denali and other Icon & Core items earn nothing, as do coupon-code orders.

item.title: Rakuten Bloomingdale's cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?
item.description: Rakuten's Bloomingdale's page showed 12% (was 2%) on November 25, 2026. Gift cards, phone orders and 5 or more of one item earn nothing.

item.title: Rakuten Office Depot cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?
item.description: Rakuten's Office Depot page showed 2% on November 25, 2026. Gift cards, postage stamps and Business Services Division orders earn nothing.

item.title: Rakuten Foot Locker cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?
item.description: Rakuten's Foot Locker page showed 9% (was 3%) on November 25, 2026. Jordan Retro, New Balance 550 and several Nike lines earn nothing.

item.title: Rakuten Levi's cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?
item.description: Rakuten's Levi's page showed 10% (was 2%) on November 25, 2026. Gift cards, collaboration collections and bulk orders earn nothing.

item.title: Rakuten Vrbo cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?
item.description: Rakuten's Vrbo page showed 3% (was 1%) on November 25, 2026. Bookings under $20 and "RAF" codes earn nothing; it posts after the stay.

item.title: Rakuten Newegg cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?
item.description: 1% on November 25, 2026, with no raised rate. Gift cards earn nothing, and coupon codes with seven named prefixes cancel the cash back.

item.title: Rakuten Staples cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?
item.description: Up to 6% on November 25, 2026, raised from 2%. Ink, toner and tech earn 2%. Computers, tablets, HP printers and gift cards earn nothing.

item.title: Rakuten TurboTax cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?
item.description: 5% on November 25, 2026, on paid online federal filings only. State filings, free filings and downloaded software earn nothing.

item.title: Rakuten Sonos cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?
item.description: 2% on November 25, 2026, with no raised rate. Gift cards and dealer orders earn nothing, and a code not listed on Rakuten voids cash back.

item.title: Rakuten Skechers cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?
item.description: 3% on November 25, 2026, with no raised rate. Orders over $500, five or more of one item, gift cards and loyalty rewards earn nothing.

item.title: Rakuten Banana Republic cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?
item.description: 2% on November 25, 2026, with no raised rate. Gift cards, the Peter Do Collection, Banana Republic Home and the part paid with points earn nothing.

item.title: Rakuten Academy Sports cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?
item.description: 2% on November 25, 2026, with no raised rate. Clearance and sale items, Hot Deals, firearms, ammunition and gift cards earn nothing.

item.title: Rakuten Neiman Marcus cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?
item.description: 15% on November 25, 2026, raised from 2%. Jewelry, watches, Prada, gift cards, phone orders and app orders earn nothing.

item.title: Rakuten CVS cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?
item.description: 3% on November 25, 2026, with no raised rate. Prescriptions, CVS app orders, gift cards and the part paid with ExtraBucks earn nothing.

item.title: Rakuten Verizon cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?
item.description: Up to $150 per order on November 25, 2026 (was $75), for new service. Upgrades, bring-your-own-device, prepaid and accessories earn nothing.
